# Large Fields Requirements Checklist: 录制数据大字段按需读取

**Purpose**: 以 reviewer 口径检查当前大字段占位与分段读取需求是否完整、清晰、一致、可衡量，避免把需求缺口带入实现阶段

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are `describe_data`, `query_data`, and `read_field_chunk` requirements each specified for their externally visible contract, rather than only describing the new happy path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-004, Contract §1, Contract §2, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK002 Are placeholder fields fully specified for readable and blocked states, including when `read_blocked_reason` is required and what it must communicate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-003a, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK003 Are chunk-read request and response fields fully specified, including optional `length`, default length behavior, and unified success/error response shape? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Contract §3, Contract §4]
- [x] CHK004 Are configuration requirements complete for all three tunables and their runtime effect boundaries, without implying a hidden field-level allow-list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-011a, Data Model §LargeFieldConfig]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the trigger rule for placeholder replacement unambiguous for any non-null text cell whose value reaches `threshold_chars`, including direct fields, aliases, and computed result columns? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the distinction between source field name, SQL alias, and result-column name clear enough to review the `field` value in placeholders and chunk-read requests? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Key Entities, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK007 Is "按字符计" tied consistently to Python `str` Unicode code-point semantics for `size_chars`, `offset`, `length`, `returned_length`, and `total_length`? [Clarity, Spec §Character Counting Semantics, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Are "blocked continuation", "unsupported continuation", EOF, and structured error semantics defined as distinct states rather than overlapping informal labels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003a, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are spec, plan, data model, and contract consistent that placeholder replacement applies broadly to text cells, while continuation depends on direct source-field lineage plus a stable same-row locator? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Summary, Data Model §LargeFieldPlaceholder, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK010 Are spec and contract consistent that runtime config changes affect threshold, preview, and chunk size only, and do not invalidate an existing `locator` by themselves? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §3]
- [x] CHK011 Are the error-code requirements in the spec aligned with the enumerated error codes in the data model and contract, with no missing or contradictory failure category? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §ChunkReadError codes, Contract §5]
- [x] CHK012 Are document/prompt/config update requirements aligned between FR-016, SC-005, and the plan's affected-file list? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Constitution Check, Plan §Project Structure]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can SC-001 be objectively judged from the requirements, including the exact role of `preview_chars`, fixed metadata, and the approximate 2KB delivery expectation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK014 Can SC-002 be objectively judged for arbitrary-range reads without requiring an implementer to invent extra rules for chunk boundaries or `has_more` / `next_offset` behavior? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 Is SC-003's 200ms target specified with enough measurement scope to avoid ambiguity about what time is included or excluded? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK016 Is SC-004's "零回归" requirement scoped clearly enough to identify which small-field behavior must remain unchanged? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-013]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are primary, alternate, exception, and recovery scenarios all represented for placeholder creation, blocked placeholder continuation, successful chunk reads, EOF reads, deleted records, and invalid parameters? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK018 Are mixed-result scenarios covered where one query result contains multiple large fields, some readable placeholders, and some blocked placeholders? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK019 Are supported and unsupported SQL lineage examples sufficient to anchor review decisions for joins, aliases, aggregates, computed columns, and ambiguous locator sources? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §2]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are threshold-boundary values defined clearly for below-threshold, exactly-at-threshold, and barely-over-threshold text values? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK021 Are null, non-text, missing-field, unknown-table, invalid-locator, and filtered-record cases specified consistently across placeholder and chunk-read requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §ChunkReadRequest, Data Model §ChunkReadError codes]
- [x] CHK022 Are runtime changes between placeholder generation and later chunk reads covered without contradicting the no field-level allow-list decision? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Are privacy and filtering requirements for `network_requests` expressed as hard requirements in the spec, not only as implementation notes in the plan? [Security, Spec §CC-003a, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK024 Are observability requirements for blocked, unsupported, and error paths specific enough to determine what structured log dimensions are required? [Observability, Spec §CC-008, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK025 Are deterministic behavior requirements explicit for placeholder generation and chunk-read metadata, including the exclusion of LLM summarization or semantic extraction? [Non-Functional, Spec §CC-004, Spec §CC-007, Plan §Constraints]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK026 Are stable locator assumptions documented well enough to review which tables and ID fields can support continuation today, and how future schema additions are handled? [Assumption, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §StableLocatorRule]
- [x] CHK027 Are the dependencies on `FilteredDuckDBConnection`, `sql_rewriter`, `sqlglot`, and unified config captured at the right requirement/design boundary without leaking implementation detail into user-facing requirements? ## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK028 Are all superseded clarification decisions either reflected in normative requirements or clearly marked as obsolete, so reviewers do not treat old JSON-budget language as current policy? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-011a, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK029 Are remaining qualitative phrases such as "上下文安全范围", "固定小结构", and "稳定定位字段" backed by measurable limits or explicit definitions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-011a, Spec §Key Entities]

## Implementation Readiness — Configuration (Phase 1, T001–T005)

- [x] CHK030 Are `LargeFieldConfig` dataclass field names, types, and default values (`threshold_chars=1000`, `preview_chars=1000`, `max_chunk_chars=1000`) specified precisely enough for an implementer to write the dataclass without additional design decisions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §LargeFieldConfig, Tasks T002]
- [x] CHK031 Is the config loading path (`recording.large_field.*` namespace via `UnifiedConfigManager`) specified with enough detail — method name, namespace key format, fallback behavior — to implement T003 without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Tasks T003]
- [x] CHK032 Are `config.example.json` defaults required to match the spec-stated defaults exactly, and is this traceability requirement documented as a hard constraint rather than a convention? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Tasks T004, Spec §Assumptions]

## Implementation Readiness — SQL Projection Analyzer (Phase 2, T006–T009)

- [x] CHK033 Are `StableLocatorRule`'s required fields (`recommended_id_field`, `describe_locator_fields`) and their per-table values (`network_requests`→`request_id`, `actions`→`action_id`, `sibling_snapshots`→`snapshot_id`) specified precisely enough to implement without guessing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §StableLocatorRule, Tasks T006]
- [x] CHK034 Are the `ProjectionBinding` dataclass fields and their semantics — which carry source-table lineage, which carry alias vs canonical name — documented precisely enough for the analyzer to produce bindings the placeholder builder can consume? [Completeness, Data Model §ProjectionBinding, Tasks T006]
- [x] CHK035 Is the `analyze_query_projections(sql, schema_info)` interface specified with input types, output structure, and edge behavior (malformed SQL, empty result) precise enough for a clean unit test boundary? [Clarity, Tasks T006, Contract §2]
- [x] CHK036 Are the test scenarios for the projection analyzer (direct column, alias, join locator, computed expression, aggregate, uncovered table, ambiguous join) enumerated completely enough to map each `read_blocked_reason` enum value to at least one test case? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003a, Data Model §ChunkReadError codes, Tasks T007]

## Implementation Readiness — Placeholder Replacement (Phase 3, T010–T016)

- [x] CHK037 Is the `LargeFieldPlaceholder` builder's output schema fully specified for both readable-locator and blocked-locator states, including which fields are mandatory vs optional in each variant? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-003a, Tasks T013]
- [x] CHK038 Is the removal of `_MAX_QUERY_CELL_CHARS = 12_000` specified as a complete replacement (not an additive layer), with clear scope of what code paths change and what remains untouched? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Tasks T014]
- [x] CHK039 Are the structured-log fields for blocked/unsupported placeholder paths specified with concrete field names and value types, enabling T015 to write log statements without inventing the schema? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, Spec §CC-008, Tasks T015]

## Implementation Readiness — Chunk Read Tool (Phase 4, T017–T021)

- [x] CHK040 Is the `read_field_chunk` request validation pipeline specified as a deterministic sequence — parameter bounds → locator table/field schema check → StableLocatorRule coverage → data access — so implementer can code the full chain without ordering ambiguity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-009, Tasks T019a]
- [x] CHK041 Are the two read strategies (filtered read via `sql_rewriter` for `network_requests` vs parameterized single-row read for other `StableLocatorRule`-covered tables) specified with clear routing criteria and no hidden third path? [Clarity, Spec §CC-003a, Plan §Constitution Check, Tasks T019b]
- [x] CHK042 Is the `ChunkReadResponse` success-path construction logic — `content` slicing, `returned_length == len(content)`, `total_length` source, `has_more` / `next_offset` derivation — specified precisely enough to implement with no open questions? - [x] CHK043 Is the tool registration requirement (exactly 5 tools from `create_recording_tools()`) specified with ordering semantics — does `read_field_chunk` position matter, or is set membership sufficient? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Tasks T020]

## Implementation Readiness — Paging & Error Completeness (Phase 5, T022–T027)

- [x] CHK044 Are all 9 error codes (`invalid_offset`, `invalid_length`, `unknown_table`, `field_not_found`, `non_text_field`, `unknown_id_field`, `record_unavailable`, `unsupported_continuation`, `internal_error`) each mapped to exactly one trigger condition with no overlap or coverage gap? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §ChunkReadError codes, Tasks T023]
- [x] CHK045 Is the EOF response shape (`content=""`, `returned_length=0`, `has_more=false`, `next_offset=null`) specified identically for both "offset at exact total_length" and "offset beyond total_length" cases, so tests need not distinguish? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Tasks T022]
- [x] CHK046 Are runtime config-change test scenarios specified precisely — which config values change, which existing `locator` stays valid, what gets re-validated on next access — so T026 can write deterministic assertions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases, Tasks T026]
- [x] CHK047 Are the structured-log requirements for failed chunk reads specified with `error.code`, table, field, and locator context as mandatory dimensions, or does the implementer need to infer which fields are log-worthy? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, Tasks T025]
